OP-18 The Dominance of God — frequently asked questions

When does OP-18 release?

Bandai lists November 21, 2026 for the Japanese release and November 20, 2026 for English. Both official product pages were checked October 14, 2026.

What is OP-18 called?

The Japanese title is 神の支配 (Kami no Shihai); Bandai's English name is BOOSTER PACK -THE DOMINANCE OF GOD-.

Is there an English OP-18 release date?

Yes. Bandai's English product page lists November 20, 2026 — one day before the Japanese date — at USD $4.99 per pack.
